Subject: Penn Wharton Global Youth Leadership Initiative – Summer Cohort 2026 – 2 seats, scholarship available – needs quick turnaround

Hi all,

A bit of an urgent one — we received a late communication from the Wharton School (University of Pennsylvania) re: their Global Youth Leadership Initiative summer programme. They've offered us 2 sponsored seats for Summer 2026 and the deadline is tight.

Programme: Penn Wharton Global Youth Leadership Initiative (GYLI) 2026
Location: Philadelphia, PA, USA (on-campus, residential)
Dates: July 12 – August 2, 2026 (3 weeks)
Format: Intensive cohort — case studies, guest speakers from Fortune 500 companies, team consulting projects, and a final pitch to a panel of Wharton faculty and industry judges.

WHAT'S COVERED (for Plaksha nominees specifically):
Programme fee (USD 5,800) is FULLY WAIVED for Plaksha nominees under our partnership agreement.
Return economy airfare: up to USD 1,200 reimbursed by Plaksha (submit receipts on return).
On-campus accommodation and meals: covered by the programme fee waiver.
Pocket money / incidental expenses: student's own responsibility.

SO NET COST TO STUDENT IS NEAR-ZERO. Please communicate this clearly — we don't want eligible students to opt out thinking it's expensive.

WHO IS THIS FOR?
This is not a technical research programme. It is a leadership, strategy, and entrepreneurship programme. The ideal Plaksha candidate:
- Has strong communication and team skills
- Has demonstrated initiative — clubs, startups, social projects, competitions
- Is interested in management, entrepreneurship, or tech-business strategy roles
- Does NOT need to be a CS major — in fact Wharton values interdisciplinary cohorts

Eligibility (Wharton's requirements):
- Must be enrolled in an undergraduate programme (not yet graduated)
- Minimum GPA equivalent to B+ (roughly CGPA 7.0/10)
- English fluency required (no formal test needed — Wharton will conduct a brief video screening)
- Not a final-year student (must return to campus for at least one more semester after the programme)

PLAKSHA INTERNAL DEADLINE: May 20, 2026 (we need to submit to Wharton by May 25)

DOCUMENTS FOR INTERNAL REVIEW:
- One-page personal statement: your leadership experience and why this programme
- Resume / CV
- One recommendation letter from a Plaksha faculty or staff member who can speak to leadership/initiative
- Latest unofficial transcript

There's no minimum CGPA hurdle that OGE will enforce here beyond Wharton's B+ guideline (CGPA 7.0). OAA sign-off on good standing (no misconduct, no suspension) is still required.

Please note: Wharton will do their own screening via a 10-minute video call with shortlisted candidates. OGE's role is to send 4–5 strong candidates; Wharton will select 2 from our list.

Time is tight. Please share with students today and ask interested students to contact oge@plaksha.edu.in by May 15 to start the packet.

Thanks and apologies for the short notice,
Meera Venkatesh
Global Engagement Coordinator
oge@plaksha.edu.in | ext. 4421
